standard_prerequisites.name: Ringed site, O-modules and complexes
standard_prerequisites.statement: A ringed site (C, O) with the abelian category of O-modules and its category of complexes, together with the homotopy category K(O) of complexes.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the setting of the statement and of the derived category D(O) in which the right adjoint lands (source lines 6278-6290).

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived tensor product with a fixed complex
standard_prerequisites.statement: The functor K(Mod_(E,d)) to K(O) induced by tensoring with K^bullet has a left derived version - tensor^L_E K^bullet defined on all of D(E,d) (the author's lemma-tensor-with-complex-derived, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the functor whose being a left adjoint is asserted (statement, source line 6282).

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived Hom
standard_prerequisites.statement: The existence of the derived functor R Hom(K^bullet, -) : D(O) to D(E,d) (the author's lemma-existence-of-derived, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the functor whose being a right adjoint is asserted (statement, source line 6290).

standard_prerequisites.name: Property (P) and K-injective replacements
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every dg E-module is quasi-isomorphic to a dg module with property (P), which carries an admissible filtration with graded projective pieces; every complex of O-modules has a K-injective replacement, and the derived Hom only depends on quasi-isomorphism classes (the author's lemmas lemma-property-P-sequence and lemma-hom-derived, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: They are what allows M and L^bullet to be replaced inside the proof and the graded computation to be reduced along the filtration (source lines 6301-6326).

core_obligations: Unwind the adjunction: show that the statement is equivalent to a bifunctorial isomorphism between Hom-groups in D(E,d) and in D(O) (source lines 6296-6301).

Justify the replacements and translate: replace M by a dg E-module P with property (P) and L^bullet by a K-injective complex I^bullet, and use the author's derived-Hom computation to rewrite the two sides as Hom-groups in the homotopy categories (source lines 6301-6312).

Reduce along the filtration: using that both sides are homological in P and turn direct sums in P into direct products, reduce first to a single filtration piece and then to a graded projective E-module (source lines 6312-6327).
Conclude: verify the isomorphism in the case P = E[k], observe compatibility with differentials and deduce the claimed adjunction (source lines 6327-6335).

proof_roadmap.step: Rewrite the adjunction as the bifunctorial Hom-isomorphism that has to be proved.
Replace M by a property-(P) module and L^bullet by a K-injective complex, and translate into homotopy-category Hom-groups.
Use the evaluation map and the property-(P) filtration to reduce to a graded projective E-module.
Check the graded isomorphism on P = E[k] and conclude by compatibility with differentials.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-tensor-with-complex-hom-adjoint at source lines 6276-6293: for a ringed site and a complex of O-modules K^bullet, the left derived functor - tensor^L_E K^bullet of the earlier lemma is a left adjoint of the derived Hom R Hom(K^bullet, -) of the earlier existence lemma. The proof at source lines 6295-6336 unwinds the adjunction into a bifunctorial isomorphism of Hom-groups and then has to justify two replacements (M by a dg E-module P with property (P), L^bullet by a K-injective complex), translate the two derived functors into morphisms in the homotopy categories by the author's derived-Hom computation, and reduce the resulting graded statement along the property-(P) filtration to the case where P is a graded projective E-module, where the isomorphism is visible on P = E[k] and compatible with differentials. None of the individual steps is deep, but the card's substance is knowing which replacements are legitimate in the derived category and why the filtration reduction is allowed, and the statement itself lists only the adjunction.
